name: vurvey
description: Connect Claude to a Vurvey workspace. Hosted connector: paste your workspace address, approve it in Vurvey, and ask about your campaigns, responses, agents and workflows. Nothing to install.

VURVEY_MCP_URL.title: Workspace connector address
VURVEY_MCP_URL.description: Copy it from Workspace settings, then Connected apps, in Vurvey. It names one workspace.
